subtopics.scope: Confirm the app is on the default stable @cloudflare/sandbox package with the matching stable container image, and route to sandbox-next or sandbox-migrate-to-next when the ask is 1.0/new-work/port; never mix package and image lines.

subtopics.scope: The stable command contract: sandbox.exec takes a command string and resolves on finish with buffered stdout/stderr/exitCode; long-running and streaming work use stable startProcess and execStream, not @next single-handle output() APIs.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Sandbox commands API exec startProcess execStream documentation
Cloudflare Sandbox background processes streaming output guide

subtopics.scope: Sessions preserve working directory and environment across commands: default session / enableDefaultSession and createSession, when state must carry across calls.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Sandbox sessions concept enableDefaultSession createSession

subtopics.scope: Filesystem surfaces: Files API (readFile/writeFile/readDir), file watching, Storage API and mounted buckets, plus Backups API for snapshot and restore.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Sandbox files API readFile writeFile readDir documentation
Cloudflare Sandbox storage API mount buckets backups API

subtopics.scope: Exposing work: Ports API, expose services and preview URLs, Tunnels API, and proxying requests from the Worker to the sandbox (proxyToSandbox, Workers connections), including production preview hostname wildcard DNS.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Sandbox ports API expose services preview URL
Cloudflare Sandbox tunnels API proxy requests workers connections

subtopics.scope: Interactive and compute surfaces: sandbox.terminal(request) browser terminals with session/xterm helpers, the code Interpreter API, git workflows in the sandbox, and Docker-in-Docker.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Sandbox terminal API browser terminal xterm
Cloudflare Sandbox code interpreter API git workflows docker-in-docker

subtopics.scope: Configuration and secrets discipline: non-secret config in sandbox env vars, live credentials stay in the Worker, outbound traffic handlers when sandbox processes call external APIs.

Cloudflare Sandbox outbound traffic egress handlers guide

subtopics.scope: Cleaning deprecated stable APIs while staying on stable (2026 deprecation guide): HTTP/WebSocket transport to RPC, exposePort, execStream/readFileStream/writeFileStream and enableDefaultSession surface changes; update package plus matching image first.

Cloudflare Sandbox deprecated APIs exposePort readFileStream writeFileStream enableDefaultSession
